Rule.Name: AzForgeMod
Rule.Description: What this mod calls itself, what it needs, and where the game is

Category.Name: Game
Category.Description: Where it is installed and run

StringProperty.Name: AzForgeModId
StringProperty.Description: What names this mod everywhere, and what the load order holds. Two mods with the same id are the same mod.

StringProperty.Name: AzForgeModVersion
StringProperty.Description: The mod's own version, not the API's.

StringProperty.Name: AzForgeModDescription
StringProperty.Description: One line, shown beside the name.

StringProperty.Name: AzForgeModRequires
StringProperty.Description: Subsystems the mod cannot work without, separated by semicolons - console;camera;world. The loader refuses to load the mod rather than hand it a table that is not there.

StringProperty.Name: AzForgeModIcon
StringProperty.Description: A .bmp shown on the MODS screen. It is put in the container's root, not among the resources.

StringProperty.Name: AzForgeGameDir
StringProperty.Description: Where game.exe lives. The mod is installed into its mods folder, and F5 runs it.

StringProperty.Name: AzForgeResourceDir
StringProperty.Description: Everything in here is shipped in the mod, laid out the way the game asks for it: scripts\, textures\, models\. Defaults to resmod beside the project.

StringProperty.Name: AzForgeSdkDir
StringProperty.Description: The folder holding include\ForgeApi.h. api_version is read from it.

StringProperty.Name: AmodPackPath
StringProperty.Description: The tool that seals the package into a .amod and installs it.
